name: favourite-with-no-icon-shows-its-initial
description: A favourite whose icon never arrives used to be an empty 16px square. It now shows the first letter of its host (www. dropped, upper case) on a plate in the host's own hue. The plate sits under the img, so the second favourite, whose icon does load, covers its letter. The letter is the host's, not the title's: the dead favourite is titled Zebra and must show N.

actions.note: the control: the served favourite's icon lands
give the dead host's lookup time to give up

actions.expression: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('.fav[data-fav-id*="nowhere-at-all"]'); if (!f) { return 'no tile'; } const p = f.querySelector('.fvinit'); return (p ? p.textContent : 'no plate') + '|' + (f.querySelector('.fvimg.ok') ? 'icon' : 'no-icon'); })()
actions.note: THE MEASUREMENT: the dead favourite shows N (from www.nowhere-at-all.test, not from the title Zebra) and no icon

actions.expression: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.fav[data-fav-id*="nowhere-at-all"] .fvinit'); if (!p) { return 'no plate'; } const r = p.getBoundingClientRect(); const cs = getComputedStyle(p); return 'w' + Math.round(r.width) + ' h' + Math.round(r.height) + ' bg=' + cs.backgroundColor + ' ink=' + cs.color; })()
actions.note: recorded: the plate fills the 16px chip, and its background and ink differ
THE OTHER HALF: the img comes after the plate, and the plate is gone once the icon has loaded

assertions.desc: the dead favourite shows its host's initial and no icon
the loaded icon sits above the plate, and the plate is hidden
